### const UpperLower

```go
const UpperLower = MaxRune + 1
```

If the Delta field of a [CaseRange](unicode.md#type-caserange) is UpperLower, it means this CaseRange represents a sequence of the form (say) [Upper](unicode.md#var-upper) [Lower](unicode.md#var-lower) [Upper](unicode.md#var-upper) [Lower](unicode.md#var-lower).

### const Version

Version is the Unicode edition from which the tables are derived.

## Functions

### func In

```go
func In(r rune, ranges ...*RangeTable) bool
```

In reports whether the rune is a member of one of the ranges.

### func Is

```go
func Is(rangeTab *RangeTable, r rune) bool
```

Is reports whether the rune is in the specified table of ranges.

### func IsControl

```go
func IsControl(r rune) bool
```

IsControl reports whether the rune is a control character. The [C](unicode.md#var-c) ([Other](unicode.md#var-other)) Unicode category includes more code points such as surrogates; use [Is](unicode.md#func-is)(C, r) to test for them.

### func IsDigit

```go
func IsDigit(r rune) bool
```

IsDigit reports whether the rune is a decimal digit.

### func IsGraphic

```go
func IsGraphic(r rune) bool
```

IsGraphic reports whether the rune is defined as a Graphic by Unicode. Such characters include letters, marks, numbers, punctuation, symbols, and spaces, from categories [L](unicode.md#var-l), [M](unicode.md#var-m), [N](unicode.md#var-n), [P](unicode.md#var-p), [S](unicode.md#var-s), [Zs](unicode.md#var-zs).

### func IsLetter

```go
func IsLetter(r rune) bool
```

IsLetter reports whether the rune is a letter (category [L](unicode.md#var-l)).

### func IsLower

```go
func IsLower(r rune) bool
```

IsLower reports whether the rune is a lower case letter.

### func IsMark

```go
func IsMark(r rune) bool
```

IsMark reports whether the rune is a mark character (category [M](unicode.md#var-m)).

### func IsNumber

```go
func IsNumber(r rune) bool
```

IsNumber reports whether the rune is a number (category [N](unicode.md#var-n)).

### func IsOneOf

```go
func IsOneOf(ranges []*RangeTable, r rune) bool
```

IsOneOf reports whether the rune is a member of one of the ranges. The function "In" provides a nicer signature and should be used in preference to IsOneOf.

### func IsPrint

```go
func IsPrint(r rune) bool
```

IsPrint reports whether the rune is defined as printable by Go. Such characters include letters, marks, numbers, punctuation, symbols, and the ASCII space character, from categories [L](unicode.md#var-l), [M](unicode.md#var-m), [N](unicode.md#var-n), [P](unicode.md#var-p), [S](unicode.md#var-s) and the ASCII space character. This categorization is the same as [IsGraphic](unicode.md#func-isgraphic) except that the only spacing character is ASCII space, U+0020.

### func IsPunct

```go
func IsPunct(r rune) bool
```

IsPunct reports whether the rune is a Unicode punctuation character (category [P](unicode.md#var-p)).

### func IsSpace

```go
func IsSpace(r rune) bool
```

IsSpace reports whether the rune is a space character as defined by Unicode's White Space property; in the Latin-1 space this is

	'\t', '\n', '\v', '\f', '\r', ' ', U+0085 (NEL), U+00A0 (NBSP).

Other definitions of spacing characters are set by category Z and property [Pattern\_White\_Space](unicode.md#var-pattern_white_space).

### func IsSymbol

```go
func IsSymbol(r rune) bool
```

IsSymbol reports whether the rune is a symbolic character.

### func IsTitle

```go
func IsTitle(r rune) bool
```

IsTitle reports whether the rune is a title case letter.

### func IsUpper

```go
func IsUpper(r rune) bool
```

IsUpper reports whether the rune is an upper case letter.

### func SimpleFold

```go
func SimpleFold(r rune) rune
```

SimpleFold iterates over Unicode code points equivalent under the Unicode-defined simple case folding. Among the code points equivalent to rune (including rune itself), SimpleFold returns the smallest rune > r if one exists, or else the smallest rune >= 0. If r is not a valid Unicode code point, SimpleFold(r) returns r.

For example:

	SimpleFold('A') = 'a'
	SimpleFold('a') = 'A'

	SimpleFold('K') = 'k'
	SimpleFold('k') = '\u212A' (Kelvin symbol, K)
	SimpleFold('\u212A') = 'K'

	SimpleFold('1') = '1'

	SimpleFold(-2) = -2

### func To

```go
func To(_case int, r rune) rune
```

To maps the rune to the specified case: [UpperCase](unicode.md#const-uppercase), [LowerCase](unicode.md#const-lowercase), or [TitleCase](unicode.md#const-titlecase).

### func ToLower

```go
func ToLower(r rune) rune
```

ToLower maps the rune to lower case.

### func ToTitle

```go
func ToTitle(r rune) rune
```

ToTitle maps the rune to title case.

### func ToUpper

```go
func ToUpper(r rune) rune
```

ToUpper maps the rune to upper case.

## Types

### type CaseRange

```go
type CaseRange struct { ... }
```

CaseRange represents a range of Unicode code points for simple (one code point to one code point) case conversion. The range runs from Lo to Hi inclusive, with a fixed stride of 1. Deltas are the number to add to the code point to reach the code point for a different case for that character. They may be negative. If zero, it means the character is in the corresponding case. There is a special case representing sequences of alternating corresponding Upper and Lower pairs. It appears with a fixed Delta of

	{UpperLower, UpperLower, UpperLower}

The constant UpperLower has an otherwise impossible delta value.

#### field CaseRange.Lo

```go
Lo uint32
```

lowest code point in the range

#### field CaseRange.Hi

```go
Hi uint32
```

highest code point in the range

#### field CaseRange.Delta

```go
Delta d
```

case mapping deltas

### type Range16

```go
type Range16 struct { ... }
```

Range16 represents of a range of 16-bit Unicode code points. The range runs from Lo to Hi inclusive and has the specified stride.

#### field Range16.Lo

```go
Lo uint16
```

lowest code point in the range

#### field Range16.Hi

```go
Hi uint16
```

highest code point in the range

#### field Range16.Stride

```go
Stride uint16
```

range stride

### type Range32

```go
type Range32 struct { ... }
```

Range32 represents of a range of Unicode code points and is used when one or more of the values will not fit in 16 bits. The range runs from Lo to Hi inclusive and has the specified stride. Lo and Hi must always be >= 1\<\<16.

#### field Range32.Lo

```go
Lo uint32
```

lowest code point in the range

#### field Range32.Hi

```go
Hi uint32
```

highest code point in the range

#### field Range32.Stride

```go
Stride uint32
```

range stride

### type RangeTable

```go
type RangeTable struct { ... }
```

RangeTable defines a set of Unicode code points by listing the ranges of code points within the set. The ranges are listed in two slices to save space: a slice of 16-bit ranges and a slice of 32-bit ranges. The two slices must be in sorted order and non-overlapping. Also, R32 should contain only values >= 0x10000 (1\<\<16).

#### field RangeTable.R16

```go
R16 []Range16
```

16-bit ranges

#### field RangeTable.R32

```go
R32 []Range32
```

32-bit ranges

#### field RangeTable.LatinOffset

```go
LatinOffset int
```

number of entries in R16 with Hi \<= MaxLatin1

### type SpecialCase

```go
type SpecialCase []CaseRange
```

SpecialCase represents language-specific case mappings such as Turkish. Methods of SpecialCase customize (by overriding) the standard mappings.

#### func SpecialCase.ToLower

```go
func (special SpecialCase) ToLower(r rune) rune
```

ToLower maps the rune to lower case giving priority to the special mapping.

#### func SpecialCase.ToTitle

```go
func (special SpecialCase) ToTitle(r rune) rune
```

ToTitle maps the rune to title case giving priority to the special mapping.

#### func SpecialCase.ToUpper

```go
func (special SpecialCase) ToUpper(r rune) rune
```

ToUpper maps the rune to upper case giving priority to the special mapping.

## Notes

- **BUG(r):** There is no mechanism for full case folding, that is, for characters that involve multiple runes in the input or output.
